features.description: Fire in one or three directions.

review:
Tanked 3: First Blood 2 uses xLoot. Instead of paylines, character symbols move around a 4-5-6-5-6-5-4 grid and pick up gems of their own colour, while wilds can be collected by anyone. Coins worth 1x to 5,000x are also up for grabs.

Bombs fire in one or three directions, and xGlitch adds surprises. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 25,584x cap. More board game than slot.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
